- [Geographic Data Science for Applied Economists](https://carmen-cabrera.github.io/gds4eco/)
  - Description: This course provides an introduction to Geographic Data Science for applied economists using Python.
  - Authors: Prof. Dani Arribas-Bel, Prof. Diego Puga, Dr. Carmen Cabrera

- [Computational Social Science](https://www.population-science.net/)
  - Description: This module introduces computational social science, where data science meets the study of human behaviour and societal change, equipping students to analyse data and address problems related to population dynamics, human mobility and demographics.
  - Authors: Francisco Rowe, Carmen Cabrera, Elisabetta Pietrostefani

- [Geographic Data Science](https://pietrostefani.github.io/gds/)
  - Description: This module will introduce students to the field of Geographic Data Science (GDS), a discipline established at the intersection between Geographic Information Science (GIS) and Data Science.
  - Authors: Elisabetta Pietrostefani, Carmen Cabrera

- [An Introduction to Network Analysis for GIS](https://crmnca.github.io/nets4gis/)
  - Description: This workshop offers an introduction to Network Analysis.
  - Authors: Carmen Cabrera, Francisco Rowe, Andrew Renninger, Valentina Marín Maureira, Rafael Prieto-Curiel

- [Using Digital Footprint Data to Measure and Monitor Human Mobility](https://fcorowe.github.io/dfd4mobility/)
  - Description: This workshop offers an introduction to the use of digital footprint data from Meta-Facebook to analyse internal population movements.
  - Authors: Francisco Rowe, Carmen Cabrera, Miguel González-Leonardo, Ruth Neville, Andrea Nasuto
